_comment: NEEDS_NEW_DSL: 'When this is DEFENDED BY 1 or more cards, you may pay {r}' needs a trigger for defenders being declared against this attack (not ON_DEFEND, which is this card defending). ability_type corrected to TRIGGERED/ON_ATTACK to make it reachable; the timing is approximate. MAY did not read its `cost`, so the prompt was FREE and the bonus unconditional -- the card was strictly stronger than printed. The cost was also the wrong RESOURCE: 'you may pay {r}' is one resource point, and it was authored as PAY_LIFE 1.
